items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Stock Could Be Cheap As Its 66% Run Rolls On
items.summary: Lockheed Martin has pulled back in the short term even after a strong multi year run. This puts a fresh spotlight on whether the current US$509.25 share price lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With big ticket fighter jet deals, missile contracts and space projects in the headlines, the question now is how those programs translate into the intrinsic value implied by its future cash flows.
